_comment: PLACEHOLDER FILE — Melissa's dataset. Created 9 Aug 2026 so the Melissa tab renders in the same format as Joseph's. The source sheet has NOT been specified yet: Joseph will name it. Until then every ledger figure here is null/empty by design. NOTHING IN THIS FILE IS INVENTED. The only real figures are Melissa's salary, which are carried across verbatim from finance.json where Joseph already confirmed them on 9 Aug 2026. Goals, liabilities, the emergency fund and recurring commitments are household-scale and live in finance.json only — they are not duplicated here.
source: NOT YET SPECIFIED — awaiting Joseph. Melissa's income & expenses sheet.

scope.label: Melissa
scope.note: Mirrors the shape of finance.json. When the real sheet is connected, fill actuals.months, actuals.incomeByCategory and actuals.expenseByCategory the same way Joseph's are filled, and set placeholder to false.

salary.source: Confirmed by Joseph, 9 Aug 2026 (carried across from finance.json — not re-derived)

projection._note: Melissa's own projection runs on her take-home alone. No household toggle here — that is what the Combined tab is for.

actuals.note: Empty until Melissa's sheet is named. The dashboard shows 'awaiting source' rather than zeros — no month is claimed to have $0 of activity.

expenseByCategory._note: One month at a time, same as Joseph's.

balances._note: The three fields Melissa fills in on her tab. null = not yet supplied.

liabilities._note: Melissa's own liabilities. None stated yet. The household mortgage and Joseph's school loan live in finance.json and are not duplicated here.

goals._note: Goals are household-scale and are held once, in finance.json. They are shown on the shared Goals tab, not per person.

recurring._note: Melissa's own standing commitments. None stated yet.

decisions.name: Name Melissa's source sheet
decisions.detail: Everything on this tab stays empty until the sheet is specified. Once named, it fills the same way Joseph's does.
